title: Disable Physical Power Button
name: disable-physical-power-button
description: Make the laptop's physical power button do nothing on a normal press, to prevent accidental or prank shutdowns.
deepDescription: This tweak sets the physical power button action to "Do nothing" for both plugged-in and on-battery power plans, on all power schemes. A quick press of the button will no longer sleep or shut down the PC. Holding the button down for several seconds still force-powers-off the machine as a hardware failsafe, so it can't get you stuck. It is reversible and safe.
modal: This tweak disables the normal action of your laptop's physical power button so a quick press does nothing. Holding it down still hard-powers-off the PC if needed. It can be reverted safely.
